title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
expectedResult: User is successfully authenticated and redirected to the inventory page (https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html).

title: Login Attempt with Invalid Credentials
expectedResult: User remains on the login page and sees error message: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service'.

title: Login Attempt with Locked-Out User Account
expectedResult: User remains on the login page and sees error message: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

title: Login Attempt with Empty Fields
steps: Leave Username and Password fields blank
expectedResult: User remains on the login page and sees validation error message: 'Epic sadface: Username is required'.

title: Login Attempt with Empty Password Field
expectedResult: User remains on the login page and sees validation error message: 'Epic sadface: Password is required'.

title: Verify Password Input Field Masking
steps: Observe the displayed text in the Password field
Inspect the element type attribute in browser Developer Tools
expectedResult: Password characters are masked (displayed as dots/asterisks) and the input field has attribute type='password'.

title: SQL Injection Prevention in Login Form
steps: Enter "' OR '1'='1" into the Username field
Enter "' OR '1'='1" into the Password field
expectedResult: Authentication fails gracefully without exposing database errors, and user sees standard invalid user error message.

title: Direct URL Access Bypass Prevention
steps: Open a new unauthenticated browser session
expectedResult: Direct access is denied, user is redirected back to login page ('https://www.saucedemo.com'), and sees error: 'Epic sadface: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in.'
